## Checklist

- [ ] Deterministic code builds every option; the model only picks.
- [ ] No model-generated text, selector, script, or URL reaches a browser action.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has focused tests.
- [ ] Fixtures and logs contain no API keys, credentials, cookies, personal data, or private-site content.
- [ ] Irreversible actions remain gated and failed actions remain verifiable and recoverable.
- [ ] User-facing commands, events, questions, and safety behavior are documented.
- [ ] The change is focused and uses a Conventional Commit title.
